about_the_game:
Once Before Us Demo is a cooperative adventure where two players must work together to uncover the truth buried within a forgotten world. Blending mystery, exploration, and challenging puzzles, the game invites you to communicate and think creatively

  • Two-player Co-op – Built entirely around communication and collaboration. No solo mode.

  • Atmospheric World – Stylized environments and dynamic lighting create a surreal yet emotional tone.

  • Environmental Interactions – Push, pull, trigger, and combine elements to solve physical and logical challenges.

  • Occasional Tension – While not a horror game, some moments may surprise or disturb.

You and your partner are not just solving puzzles – you're uncovering what was once before you… and perhaps, what’s still ahead.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 2.8 GHz or AMD Ryzen 3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 Ti or RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 3.5 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 or RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
